title: Tanker drops on central Washington wildfire (35722492706)
description:
Three air tankers make consecutive water drops on the 37,000-acre Sutherland Canyon Fire in central Washington, June 28, 2017 – video: Richard Parrish, BLM
The lightning-started fire began June 26 and burned mostly grasses near the Columbia River, south of Wenatchee, Washington.

Single-engine air tankers, or SEATs as they are called in the wildland fire world, can carry water or retardant and are essential to firefighting. WATCH a SEAT get loaded with 800 gallons of retardant in about 4 minutes: www.youtube.com/watch?v=QmJH8p3vCPg
